definitions.explanation: The act of welcoming and entertaining guests warmly and generously. Often used in formal or diplomatic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓待|かんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓待|かんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the hospitality of the local people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国賓|こくひん}→国賓：12137_kokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歓待|かんたい}し、⟦{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}→晩餐会：13094_bansankai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The president gave the state guest a grand reception and held a banquet.

notes:
{歓待|かんたい} is a formal word for hospitality, composed of {歓|かん} (joy, delight) and {待|たい} (to treat, to entertain). It can also be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歓待|かんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a warm welcome)
- {歓待|かんたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to entertain warmly)
- ⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧な{歓待|かんたい} (a grand reception)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もてなし→もてなし：27261_motenashi⟧: hospitality — more everyday and versatile, often used for customer service
- ⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧: entertaining (business) — often implies wining and dining for business purposes
- {厚遇|こうぐう}: generous treatment — broader, not limited to welcoming guests
